# Leaflet 1.9.4

Unmodified Leaflet JavaScript, CSS and BSD-2-Clause licence, sourced from
the existing rosenfieldben/nyc-transit-live repository on 19 September 2026.

Source: https://github.com/rosenfieldben/nyc-transit-live/tree/main/frontend/vendor/leaflet

Upstream: https://leafletjs.com/

The application uses vector circle markers, not the optional PNG marker icons.
The source map is not included. No NYC application code was copied.
